EntrySet.label: Model3D
EntrySet.entry: Click: select (the group; Cmd / Ctrl: the object itself; Shift: add / remove). Drag an object or a handle: current tool (X / Y / Z: axis). Drag the background or right button: orbit, with Shift: pan; wheel: zoom. G / R / S: tools, F: frame, 1 / 3 / 7 / 5: views, arrows: move the selection (page up / down: height), Del: delete, Ctrl+D: duplicate, Ctrl+G / Shift+Ctrl+G: group / ungroup, Ctrl+A: select all, Ctrl+Z / Shift+Ctrl+Z: undo / redo (Cmd on macOS). The fields are relative to the group of the object. The output frame is what the clip shows; the convergence is at the center of the view.

8 bits: quality closest to the original model.

4 bits: slightly lower quality (details, text), for GPUs with less memory. The text encoder and VAE stages need about 7 GB whatever the variant.
